meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加、修复、调整界面组件,快速搭建标准化的前端页面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建网页界面,需要反复添加和调整现成的界面组件。
copy.tagline_en: Add, fix, and style UI components to streamline building frontend pages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web interfaces and want to easily manage and adjust UI components.

howto.what: Claude 会按 shadcn 的规则帮你添加、搜索、修复、调试、改样式和组合 UI 组件(含聊天界面),并给出项目配置、组件文档和用法示例。
howto.when: 当你的项目涉及 shadcn/ui、组件注册表、presets 等,或存在 components.json 文件时接管;提到 shadcn init 或用 --preset 建应用时也会触发。

howto.what_en: Claude manages your shadcn/ui project: adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing components and chat UIs, using your project config, component docs, and usage examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when your project uses shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, or has a components.json file, and for requests like shadcn init or creating an app with --preset.
